description: Available prompt guides for Godot 4.x game development. Use get_prompt to read any guide when you need specific knowledge.

prompts.godot4_basics: Godot 4.x core rules, renamed classes (3.x→4.x), GDScript basics, CharacterBody2D/3D movement patterns
prompts.tscn_format: .tscn scene file format (format=3): section order, ext_resource, sub_resource, node tree, signal connections
prompts.sprite_sheet: How to handle sprite sheets: Sprite2D hframes/vframes, AnimatedSprite2D + SpriteFrames + AtlasTexture
prompts.physics_2d: 2D physics: body types, collision shapes, layers/masks, RigidBody2D, raycasting, Area2D signals
prompts.physics_3d: 3D physics: body types, collision shapes, CharacterBody3D movement, camera, lighting
prompts.animation: Animation systems: AnimationPlayer keyframes, AnimatedSprite2D frames, Tween procedural animation, Timer
prompts.audio: Audio: AudioStreamPlayer/2D/3D, buses, formats (.ogg/.wav), volume/pitch, autoplay
prompts.gui_controls: GUI/HUD: layout containers, 20+ control types, anchoring, theme overrides, CanvasLayer HUD pattern
prompts.input_handling: Input: action mapping, polling, event-based, touch, mouse capture, Input.get_vector/get_axis
prompts.tilemap: TileMapLayer (NOT TileMap): setup, placing tiles, physics, programmatic generation
prompts.particles: GPU particles 2D/3D: ParticleProcessMaterial, color ramps, common effects (explosion/fire/smoke/rain)
prompts.shaders: Shaders: canvas_item/spatial/particles, ShaderMaterial, flash/outline examples, StandardMaterial3D
prompts.signals_patterns: Signals, scene management, groups, autoload singletons, state machine, object pool, screen shake
prompts.3d_models: 3D models (.glb/.gltf): instance in .tscn, animations (runtime discovery, NEVER guess names), third-person camera-relative movement, model facing, scale adjustment, correct scene structure (NO children on instanced nodes)
